column1: # REQ-057 PILOT readout — layer-wise shape-weighted spectral sharpness, step 2000, seed-0 base (SHA 365c392d).
# Node wgp5zvw (1x8 H100), venv019 torch2.10+cu128. 18 pilot matrices = all 6 types in blocks 0,6,11.
# Mean-per-valid-token loss scale (summed CE / valid tokens; token_scale in JSON). Shape-weighted radii
# r_i = sqrt(max(1,rows/cols)); all 18 pilot matrices are square or fan-out<=1 so r_i=1.0 here.
# 3 DISJOINT probe subsets = distinct train files (000001/000002/000003.bin), 8192 tok each; nested = 000001 @32768.
# FW: exact-SVD spectral-polar LMO, K in {20,50}, 5 restarts (1 grad-polar + 4 random), sphere best-boundary witness.
# Gate (a) measurement reliability: 18/18 positively-resolved sentinel S_i change <=5% from K=20 to K=50 (100%, need >=90%). Worst 4.5% (blocks.6.attn.v).
# Gate (b) cross-subset reproducibility: median pairwise Spearman of S_i/G_i across the 3 disjoint subsets = 0.983 (0.971-0.990); need >=0.8.

# HVP validation: central grad-difference vs autograd on the joint grad-polar dir: rel_err 0.75% (eps=0.005), 3.67% (0.01), 10.0% (0.02), 23.3% (0.04) -> plateau at small eps, higher-order growth at large eps. PASS.
# === isolated S_i (K=50 sphere), G_i, Z_i (eta=0.02), by matrix (subset 0) ===
# === JOINT vs ISOLATED (the information lost by treating layers independently) ===
# At the joint gradient-polar direction (subset 0): c = 94.18 ; c_diag (sum of within-matrix terms) = 12.47 ; c_cross = 81.71.
# => cross-layer coupling is 86.8% of the joint curvature. Isolated S_i captures only ~13% of the joint curvature at this direction.
# Sum of isolated S_i (K50) over the 18 pilot matrices = 60.6; joint S_joint (18-matrix sphere) is a different, larger quantity (not a sum).
# === spectral-vs-Euclidean within-type DEPTH ordering (S_i K50 by block 0/6/11) ===
# => MLP matrices are ~4-6x sharper than attention in the spectral metric; attention sharpness concentrates early. Depth ordering to be confirmed on all 72 at n=3 seeds.
# VERDICT: measurement validated -> EXPAND to 72 matrices x steps {1500,2000,2500} x seeds {0,1,2} (full stage).
